page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8a.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled, operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores ranking in the top 25%. Multi-core processing, software compilation, and database operations fall within the average tier. Memory performance is mixed; while cached small-block read-only memory bandwidth is average at 607.86 GB/sec, large-block uncached read-only memory bandwidth is relatively weak at 37.19 GB/sec. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512, vector neural network instructions (AVX512_VNNI), and Bfloat16 (AVX512_BF16), which assist in accelerating specific cryptographic and vector calculations.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r8a.2xlarge offers a dense memory allocation relative to its compute resources, making it a viable option for workloads that require significant memory capacity without demanding extreme multi-core compute scaling. Given its hardware profile, this instance is well-suited for memory-intensive applications such as medium-sized databases, caching layers, text processing pipelines, and general-purpose enterprise applications that benefit from a high RAM-to-vCPU ratio.
